bilingual.notes: NAC 391.242 (regulation T002-24, updated 2024-12-26): completion of a Department-approved bilingual preparation program OR 12 semester credits of coursework (second-language acquisition theory plus at least three of: native-language reading/language-arts methods, native-language content-area methods, second-language testing/evaluation, bilingual curriculum development, native language and culture, bilingual ed history/philosophy/theory). A Praxis language exam in the native language (e.g., Praxis Spanish) must be passed prior to issuance of the endorsement.

eld.notes: Branded as ELAD (English Language Acquisition and Development) since the late-2010s rename from the prior TESL endorsement. NAC 391.237: 11 semester hours of credit (3 each in language acquisition theory, methods for English learners, and assessment of English learners; 2 in elementary or secondary EL policies) plus a 1-semester-hour practicum (≥25 classroom hours). No exam gate. A separate Specialist in ELAD endorsement adds coursework in cultural/linguistic diversity foundations and program leadership.

sei.notes: The phase-in language reported in the 2019 baseline (early childhood/elementary 2020, middle/secondary 2021) did not produce a universal mandate. As of 2026 NAC Chapter 391 contains no general requirement that all teachers obtain ELAD or any EL-related endorsement; ELAD is a voluntary specialization.

history.title: Nevada Seal of Biliteracy enacted (AB 224, 2015)
history.description: Nevada Assembly Bill 224 (2015 session, signed 2015-06-09) created the State Seal of Biliteracy under NRS 388.5965, recognizing high school graduates proficient in English plus one or more additional languages.

history.title: Phase-in of EL endorsement for new teachers did not produce universal mandate
history.description: The 2019 baseline reported a phase-in requiring all new early-childhood/elementary teachers (2020) and middle/secondary teachers (2021) to obtain an EL endorsement. As of 2026 NAC ch. 391 contains no general mandate that all teachers hold ELAD or any EL-related endorsement; the phased rule did not result in a universal credential requirement. Captured here so the 2019 expectation is searchable against the 2026 state of regulation.

history.title: EPAA 29(100) document analysis (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Leider, Colombo & Nerlino published in Education Policy Analysis Archives 29(100) a comprehensive document analysis of every state and DC's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI teacher-credentialing requirements, professional teaching standards mentions, and EL-percentage figures, based on primary SEA sources collected October–December 2019. The 2019 coding of Nevada's EL-credentialing landscape is preserved as a temporally-anchored research baseline against which the catalog's later verifications are framed.

history.title: NAC 391 endorsements update (regulation T002-24)
history.description: Permanent regulation T002-24 amended NAC ch. 391 effective 2024-12-26, including the bilingual education endorsement requirements at NAC 391.242 and confirming the Praxis native-language proficiency exam (NAC 391.059) as a precondition for issuance. The TESL → ELAD branding is reflected throughout NAC 391.237.
